correctness.rationale: Every one of the 1025 nonempty edge-matching faces was recovered by two independent enumeration algorithms, the deterministic face matching contains 502 disjoint covering pairs and exactly one critical vertex plus twenty critical three-cells, and topological sorting establishes that all 3629 oriented Hasse incidences form a DAG. Forman’s theorem therefore yields the asserted integral wedge homotopy type; mod-2, -3, -5 chain ranks independently corroborate the ranks. No unproved infinite extrapolation or unverified attaching-map assertion is required.

value.rationale: The Frucht graph is the historically canonical cubic asymmetric graph and is verified nonouterplanar. Its ordinary matching complex has 133 maximal simplices in three distinct sizes and dimension up to five, making a complete integral three-sphere-wedge classification nontrivial and structurally informative. The explicit 502-pair Morse reduction and exact rank twenty are reusable benchmark data for matching-complex topology outside available outerplanar classifications. The claim does not rely on an unsupported universal theorem or minimality assertion.
